notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been removed.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to view this page. Please contact your system administrator if you need access.

REQUEST.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some input is invalid. Please check and try again.
REQUEST.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
REQUEST.IP_NOT_ALLOWED: Requests from this IP address are not allowed.

CONCURRENCY.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record. Reload and try again.

PERMISSION.DENIED: You do not have permission for this action.

AUTH.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Incorrect username or password. Five failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.
AUTH.CAPTCHA_INVALID: The verification code is wrong or has expired. Please try again.
AUTH.PASSWORD_EXPIRED: Your password has expired. Change it now.
AUTH.PASSWORD_REUSED: The new password must differ from the current password.

COMPANY.DUPLICATE_CODE: This company code is already in use.
COMPANY.NOT_FOUND: Company not found, or you are not authorized to manage it.

BRANCH.DUPLICATE_CODE: This branch code is already in use in the current company.

DEPARTMENT.DUPLICATE_CODE: This department code is already in use in the current company.

USER.DUPLICATE: This username is already taken (case-insensitive, including users of other companies).
USER.SELF_DEACTIVATION: You cannot deactivate your own account.
USER.NOT_FOUND: User not found. It may no longer belong to the current company.

ROLE.DUPLICATE_CODE: This role code is already in use (including deleted roles).
ROLE.IN_USE: This role is still assigned to users and cannot be deleted. Remove the assignments or deactivate it instead.
ROLE.NOT_FOUND: Role not found. It may have been deleted.

IP_WHITELIST.NOT_FOUND: IP rule not found. Reload and try again.
IP_WHITELIST.DUPLICATE: This IP range already exists for this target.

NUMBER_RULE.DUPLICATE_TYPE: A number rule already exists for this document type in the current company.
NUMBER_RULE.NOT_FOUND: Number rule not found. It may belong to another company.
NUMBER_RULE.IN_USE: Numbers have been issued with this rule: the date format and reset period are locked and the sequence length cannot be shortened.
NUMBER_RULE.SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: All sequence numbers of this period have been used. Increase the sequence length.

APPROVAL_FLOW.DUPLICATE_TYPE: An approval flow already exists for this document type in the current company.
APPROVAL_FLOW.NOT_FOUND: The approval flow was not found. It may belong to another company.

APPROVAL_DELEGATION.OVERLAP: This user already has an active delegate in this period. Periods cannot overlap.
APPROVAL_DELEGATION.NOT_FOUND: The approval delegate was not found. It may belong to another company.

APPROVAL.NOT_FOUND: The approval was not found. It may belong to another company.
APPROVAL.NOT_PENDING: This approval has already been completed or withdrawn. Please refresh.
APPROVAL.NOT_APPROVER: You are not an approver (or delegate) of the current step.
APPROVAL.SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve a document you submitted.

COMPANY_IMAGE.NOT_FOUND: The image was not found. It may have been deleted. Reload and try again.
COMPANY_IMAGE.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Only PNG and JPEG images are accepted. The file content must match.
COMPANY_IMAGE.TOO_LARGE: The image must not exceed 1 MB.
COMPANY_IMAGE.INVALID_DIMENSIONS: The image width and height must be 16–2048 pixels.

http.network: Unable to reach the server. Please check your network and try again.
http.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
